messages.Здравствуйте. По вашему счёту появилась: Hello. A loan application has appeared on your account. Did you submit it? If not, we need to protect your remaining funds urgently.
messages.Оформите перевод на резервный счёт. Пока: Transfer the money to a reserve account. While the check is in progress, you must not tell anyone about this operation, or we will be unable to protect your money.
messages.Добрый день. У вашего договора связи ист: Good afternoon. Your mobile service contract is expiring. To keep your number, you need to confirm the renewal now.
messages.Вам придёт сообщение. Просто продиктуйте: You will receive a message. Just read out the digits: it is a technical confirmation. There is no need to read the whole message.
messages.Здравствуйте. Уточняем удобное время пол: Hello. We are checking a convenient time for you to receive your parcel. We can arrange delivery, or you can choose collection at a branch.
messages.Только подходящий день и время. Коды и д: We only need a suitable day and time. No codes or card details are needed. If you would like to verify this call, check the arrangements directly with the delivery service.
messages.Привет. Машина не заводится, я задержалс: Hi. The car will not start, and I am stuck outside town. Could you pick me up or help me find a tow truck?
messages.Я на стоянке у магазина, могу прислать м: I am in the car park by the shop. I can send you my location. There is no need to send money to strangers. If convenient, call me back or get in touch with our family.
messages.Здравствуйте. По вашему дому назначаем п: Hello. We are scheduling meter inspections for your building. Would morning or evening suit you better? We will need confirmation to put you on the schedule.
messages.Продиктуйте код из сообщения. Если напис: Read out the code from the message. If it says account login, that is just standard wording. Otherwise you will not be added to the schedule.
messages.Здравствуйте. Обнаружен неучтённый перио: Hello. We have found an unrecorded period in your employment history. You may qualify for a pension increase. We need you to confirm your details now, before the list closes.
messages.Нужны реквизиты карты и код из сообщения: We need your card details and the code from the message. There is no need to gather documents. If you delay, the recalculation may not be included in this payment.
messages.Добрый день. По вашей записи освободилос: Good afternoon. An earlier appointment has become available. Would you like to discuss moving your appointment? If now is inconvenient, you can check independently later.
messages.Меняется только время. Коды и карта не н: Only the time is changing. No codes or card details are needed. We are keeping your existing appointment for now. You can confirm the change through the reception desk you already know.
messages.Здравствуйте. Вы интересовались нашим ср: Hello. You expressed an interest in our remedy. We have a treatment course especially for you with guaranteed results. The discount is only available today.
messages.Обычные назначения вам больше не понадоб: You will no longer need your usual prescribed treatments. Pay for the course by a private transfer, and you will receive the documents and recommendations afterwards.
messages.Здравствуйте. По вашей заявке на ремонт: Hello. We need to agree a visit time for your repair request. The technician will first inspect the fault and provide an estimate.
messages.Осмотр и возможная стоимость указаны в п: The inspection and any possible charge are described in your booking confirmation. Work will only start after you agree to it. No banking codes are needed over the phone.
messages.Здравствуйте. На ваше имя якобы оформляю: Hello. A loan is apparently being taken out in your name. If it is not you, you must immediately submit a matching application so the system can cancel the first one.
messages.Оформите обычный кредит и получите деньг: Take out an ordinary loan and collect the money. We will then tell you where to send it. You must not contact the bank yourself, or the cancellation will fail.
messages.Добрый день. По вашим накоплениям нужна: Good afternoon. We need to check the origin of your savings. To avoid delaying the process, hand the cash to our courier. They will complete the paperwork.
messages.Документ пришлём в мессенджер. Не обсужд: We will send the document in a messenger. Do not discuss the check with your family or call the organisation: that would breach confidentiality.
messages.Здравствуйте. По вашему обращению нужно: Hello. Regarding your enquiry, we need to confirm how you would prefer to receive a reply. We can discuss it now, or you can contact us yourself using the details you already know.
messages.Нужно выбрать время консультации. Коды,: We only need to choose a consultation time. No codes, banking access or card details are required. If you have any doubts, verify the contact first.
messages.Добрый день. Нам нужна помощь в закрытой: Good afternoon. We need your help with a confidential investigation. A transfer from your account will be required, but you must not discuss it with your bank or family.
messages.Переводите на реквизиты из сообщения. Эт: Transfer the money using the details in the message. This is necessary to investigate staff, so calling the organisation yourself will ruin the entire operation.
messages.Привет. Небольшая дорожная неприятность,: Hi. There has been a minor road incident, but I am fine. Could you help me contact the family and work out how to get home?
messages.Пожалуйста, сначала перезвони или свяжис: Please call me back first or contact our family. There is no need to pay any intermediary. We just need to arrange how I can get home.
messages.Здравствуйте. Вам якобы одобрена компенс: Hello. Compensation for your purchases has apparently been approved. To receive the money, you need to pay a small registration fee today.
messages.Условия дадим после регистрации. Сначала: We will provide the terms after registration. First, transfer money to our specialist’s card, and then you will receive a larger sum. Otherwise your application will expire.
messages.Вашему имуществу якобы угрожает чужая сд: Your property is supposedly at risk from someone else’s transaction. You must urgently make a protective sale and temporarily hand over the proceeds for inspection.
messages.Сделка будет настоящей, но потом всё вер: The sale will be real, but everything will be returned later. Do not consult your own advisers: they do not know about our operation.
